newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan to buy July jet fuel late week, skips June.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to buy July jet fuel late week, skips June.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) which did not tender buy any jet fuel for June delivery will issue a tender to buy jet fuel for delivery in July later this week, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
"We will issue a tender to buy jet fuel for July later this week or early next week," the official said.
The official said that Taiwan did not issue any tender to buy jet fuel for June delivery due to ample inventory.
CPC generally imports one or two 32,000 tonne cargoes jet fuel a month.
In its last tender, CPC bought one cargo for May 21-30 delivery at $204 per tonne on a cost-and-freight basis to Keelung or Shen Ao.
